The '''Had Abbadon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained [[Had Abbadon]],<ref name="Twitter" /> a mythical "lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]]" that some [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] scholars believed might have been the birthplace of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|5|Had Abbadon}}</ref> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[137 ABY]], it had fallen under the control of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Had Abbadon system was first identified in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />
